messages:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — co-host webinar with Palisade (hardware partner) + Azure Marketplace next Wed. Need final speaker list, demo fallbacks, and a swag + remote lab kit plan.
Mike: Got it. I can confirm keynote + 10-min product update. Do we have a run of show?
Elaine: Tentative: 5m intro, 15m Palisade HW demo, 15m Redwood inference live deploy, 15m customer panel, 10m Q&A. Need speaker names by EOD Fri.
Harpreet: Palisade will do the HW demo. @harpreet -> I can run through perf numbers and a short live inference on a mini-node.
Jin: For the live infer demo, suggest we prep a fallback video + recorded KV-cache warmup in case cloud region spikes. I can record a 90s fallback clip.
Rachael: Swag ops: proposal is 200 remote lab kits (mini GPU dongle + quick start card) for APAC/EU/NA splits. Shipping estimate attached. Link to order form: https://tiny.redwood/swag-order
swag-bot: New swag order created: order_2912 — ETA: 7-10 business days. Tracking protos will be merged into our logistics sheet. :package:
Mike: Marketing requests headshots + 2-sentence bios from speakers. Also want a one-slide demo summary for the landing page.
Elaine: @mike noted. I'll chase speakers. Also we need an Azure Marketplace blurb for the announcement — short copy (40-70 chars) + logo SVG.
Harpreet: Can Palisade provide a small remote lab image we can pre-download to kits? Shipping weight is tight.
Rachael: Yes we need a checksum and download URL to preload SD cards. Prefer single 1GB image. Send to ops@redwood.com.
Jin: Playlist for the rehearsal: 
```
- 10:00am GMT: tech check (hosts + partner)
- 10:20am GMT: run-through (full demo + fallback)
- 10:50am GMT: audience Q&A dry run
```
Elaine: Rehearsal scheduled for Tue 11:00 PDT. @jin please run the fallback clip as backup.
Mike: I'll draft the landing copy and share by tomorrow noon. Need speaker bios by EOD Fri otherwise we use canned copy.
Rachael: Swag logistics Qs: customs paperwork for EU kits — Harpreet can Palisade provide CN22 details and HS codes?
Harpreet: Yes — HS code 8471.80, value per kit USD 45. Will DM the invoice.
Mike: Can we do a small joint press blurb for marketplace launch? 2-3 sentences, non-technical.
Elaine: Yes — marketing + partners draft and legal sign-off needed. Target publish = webinar day + Marketplace listing.
Jin: Final ask: can we have a fallback route to hosted Redwood model if Palisade demo hits hardware perf issue? I can wire a quick switch in the demo script: `if hw_timeout -> call hosted_api`.
Elaine: Perfect. Jin + Harpreet coordinate on the demo toggle and the recorded fallback.
Rachael: Action items updated in the ops doc: https://tiny.redwood/ops-webinar-2912. I added shipping timeline and rehearsal link.
Elaine: Thanks everyone — please update your items. Ping me if anything blocks EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
